subject: Subprocessor continuity and continuity mapping — vendor consolidation notice
messages:
From: operations@cloudsafe.io

Cc: 
Date: Fri, 08 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Planned provider consolidation affecting subprocessor mapping

Good morning Rafael / Marissa,

Quick heads-up from CloudSafe Ops: we are consolidating a small number of backend analytics vendors as part of our Q3 cost and continuity program. This will affect the subprocessor mapping for a subset of our customers (see summary below).

Summary:
- Change: AnalyticsPartnerX -> consolidated into CloudSafe-InternalAnalytics (a CloudSafe-controlled stack)
- Effective date: 2026-06-30 (planned)
- Impact: No change to primary compute regions; some telemetry ingestion endpoints will be migrated to CloudSafe-owned collectors.
- Compliance: we will maintain existing SOC 2 coverages; we plan to provide updated attestation artifacts and an updated subprocessor matrix next week.

Action requested: Please confirm whether you need the full vendor contracts, a scoped SOC 2 addendum, or a signed change notice (DocuSign). We can provide a mapping file and the summary PDF.

Attaching: (will share via secure link) subprocessor_matrix_v3.xlsx and SOC2_summary.pdf once ready.

Best,
Lee Park
Operations Manager, CloudSafe Inc.
operations@cloudsafe.io

From: rafael_mendes@redwood.com
To: operations@cloudsafe.io
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 08 May 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Planned provider consolidation affecting subprocessor mapping

Thanks Lee — appreciate the heads-up. A few quick questions from our side (security & procurement):

1) Data flows: Will the CloudSafe-InternalAnalytics collectors have access to customer PII or unredacted logs? If yes, which types and how long are they retained?
2) KMS / keys: Are keys customer-specific (BYOK) or shared? For customers with region / KMS restrictions (e.g., BigBank) we need a clear statement.
3) Rollback / continuity: If the consolidation causes regression, what is your rollback plan and SLA for remediation?
4) Evidence: We will need an updated subprocessor matrix (csv/xlsx), the SOC 2 summary you mentioned, and any data processing addenda or signed change notice for our legal team and for BigBank procurement.

Please send the files and specify the DocuSign change notice link if you prefer that route. We have BigBank's procurement and security teams on standby to review — copying Karhtik to help with technical follow-up.

Short timeline ask: can we get the artifacts by Mon, 2026-05-10 so we can review before their EUM meeting on 2026-05-13?

Thanks,
Rafael Mendes
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rafael_mendes@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0132

From: operations@cloudsafe.io

Cc: sandra.lee@bigbank.com, procurement@bigbank.com
Date: Sun, 10 May 2026 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Planned provider consolidation affecting subprocessor mapping

Hi Rafael / team — thanks for the quick reply. See attached artifacts (secure download links included below) and short answers inline.

Attachments provided:
- subprocessor_matrix_v3.xlsx (full mapping, updated 2026-05-10)
- SOC2_summary.pdf (scope & control changes)

Short answers to your Qs:
1) Data flows: CloudSafe-InternalAnalytics will only receive pseudonymized telemetry by default; no customer PII will be forwarded unless explicitly configured by the customer. We note exceptions in the matrix column "data_categories" for customers who have opted in to detailed traces. Retention: default 90 days; archival only for 2-year retention customers (flagged in matrix).
2) KMS: Keys are tenant-dedicated (per-customer keys) on supported plans and come from either CloudSafe-managed KMS or customer BYOK. BigBank is on BYOK — we will not move keys off their KMS.
3) Rollback: we will keep the previous ingestion pipeline live for a 14-day canary window after migration and will maintain a hot rollback path to the prior vendor endpoints. SLA for remediation: P1 within 4 hours, full rollback within 24 hours if a continuity issue is detected.

Secure links (expires 7 days):
- https://secure.cloudsafe.io/downloads/subprocessor_matrix_v3.xlsx
- https://secure.cloudsafe.io/downloads/SOC2_summary.pdf
- DocuSign change notice: https://app.docusign.com/changes/CloudSafe-Subproc-Notice-2026

Please confirm receipt and whether the BigBank procurement team needs a signed DPA amendment — we can get the change notice routed for signature this week.

Regards,
Lee Park
Operations Manager, CloudSafe Inc.

Rafael / Marissa — quick internal note after scanning the matrix. A few items to flag for security/compliance review before we sign anything for BigBank: 

- There are three customers marked with "detailed traces" that may route higher-sensitivity material; we need a sample of the pseudonymization process (transformation rules) and a short architecture diagram showing where the collectors live (VPCs, AZs).
- Confirm that BYOK integration is validated for our supported HSM types (AWS KMS with CloudHSM, Google KMS, and Azure Key Vault). We need a confirmation from CloudSafe on a per-KMS compatibility matrix.
- Request that the DocuSign change notice include an explicit rollback clause and the 14-day canary window language in the legal addendum. Procurement will want that.

I'll draft a short list to send to CloudSafe if you want me to. If BigBank procurement jumps in directly, I'll coordinate.
